records.subject: Welcome aboard, Granite Labs
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Engaged admin: project created day 1 [calendar:1d6a1026 call held], replied positively within a day [email:0ac59666]. But 6 days in with no tasks/milestone and no invite sent, and reply suggests passive exploration ("still getting used to the layout"). 8 days left, Pro plan, no blockers or tickets — moderate odds unaided.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Glad to hear the first week is going well and that the layout is starting to click — that settling-in period is normal.

Since you've got a project up, the natural next step is filling it in: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. When you're ready to bring the rest of the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through getting your real work mapped into that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
